Profile Templates

# District Committee Job Profile Templates

Sample job profile templates for district committee positions done in Word
format so you can revise them to fit your district’s needs. These can also be
used ‘as is’ by filling in the volunteer name and key meeting dates.

  * [Activities and civic service chair](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/mission/doc/activities_civic_service_chair.doc)
